xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-1990: First-class workspaces and projects with per-workspace memory

plan.title: First-class workspaces and projects with per-workspace memory
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: Workspaces are implicit (workspaces/feature-<issue>/ dirs pinned 1:1 to issues) and memory is issue-keyed, so non-issue sessions (main, scratch) get no Overdeck affordances and no recall; dashboard layout state is ephemeral. Promote projects and workspaces to first-class entities with a kind discriminator (main|issue|scratch), re-key the existing memory subsystem from (projectId, issueId) to (projectId, workspaceId), and give every workspace a dashboard surface.
narratives.Proposal: Execute the canonical PRD drafts/pan-1990.md (decisions D-1..D-10 adopted; drift corrections in .overdeck/continue.json): new projects/workspaces/project_targets/pinned_docs tables in panopticon.db behind a resolver/writer two-door pair with a CI guard; boot seeding from projects.yaml + worktree backfill + rebuild-workspaces admin verb; pipeline integration (row-before-worktree, archive-on-closeout, deep-wipe memory exclusion, conversation workspace_id); CLI verbs (workspace new/main/get/activate/archive/list-filters/destroy --purge-memory, project add-target); memory re-key with identity records, home migration + FTS re-point, capture/injection for null-issueId turns, pins, search scope flags, state-domain mirror for summaries+pins, JSONL backfill; dashboard workspaces API, sidebar section, workspace view, Cmd-K switcher, additive workspaceId events; no-loss audit gate; docs + wrapper skills.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Cross-machine sync of rolling observations (backfill from Claude transcripts is the portability story)
- Memory curation UI / observation editing
- Auto-archival of stale workspaces
- Dashboard surfacing of project_targets secondary paths (schema + CLI land; switcher shows primaries only)
- Migrating per-issue continue files into workspace memory (different lifecycle; unchanged)
- Sidecar corpora beside memory/ (transcripts/, diffs/, activity/, notes/) — layout reserves room; not built
- Remote (Fly VM) workspace rows — ~/.overdeck/workspaces/{issueId}.yaml metadata remains as-is
- No new session-context.md artifact (PRD D-2 — extend injectPromptTimeMemory instead)
- No pan workspace delete alias (verb stays destroy, PRD D-4)
- No changes to the event-store overdeck.db or its migration system

autoDecisions.summary: Adopted the canonical PRD drafts/pan-1990.md as source of truth without writing a new workspace PRD.
autoDecisions.rationale: The PRD-first gate (checkPrdGateSync) resolves the canonical draft at the state-home drafts/ dir and promotion never overwrites an existing canonical; the PRD is complete per prd-authoring rules and the issue body defers to it.

autoDecisions.summary: Schema migration authored as current-version+1 at implementation time (63->64 today), not the PRD's 59->60.
autoDecisions.rationale: SCHEMA_VERSION advanced from 59 to 63 since the PRD was verified (2026-07-12); hardcoding invites a version collision on rebase.

autoDecisions.summary: New tables land in panopticon.db via src/lib/database/schema.ts, though the issue/PRD say overdeck.db.
autoDecisions.rationale: schema.ts (where conversations/agents live and where the PRD's WI-1 edits point) manages ~/.overdeck/panopticon.db; the event store's overdeck.db is a separate database with its own migration system.

autoDecisions.summary: Folded the 2026-07-26 reconciliation comment into the plan: idle-stack reaper joins through the resolver with an explicit kind='main' reaping exemption, and wrapper-repo git posture is documented in docs/WORKSPACES-AND-PROJECTS.md.
autoDecisions.rationale: The comment states both reaper tiers should stop tmux-name scraping when this lands, and that main-kind workspaces are excluded today only incidentally; the wrapper-posture note asks for exactly this documentation.

autoDecisions.summary: pan project add-target --primary demotes the previous primary rather than erroring.
autoDecisions.rationale: The partial unique index requires exactly one primary; demotion is the least-surprising upsert semantic and matches the writer-owns-invariants door design.

autoDecisions.summary: Kept one mega-plan with plan.metadata.sizeJustification instead of decomposing into sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue body explicitly mandates delivery as one complete feature with no partial-delivery milestones; the PRD repeats it.

autoDecisions.summary: Ignored the PRD's 'Beads, not TODO lists' intersecting rule.
autoDecisions.rationale: Beads/bd/Dolt were removed in PAN-2648 after the PRD was written; task tracking runs through the pan task door against this xBRIEF.

metadata.sizeJustification: The issue body mandates single-issue delivery: 'This is delivered as one complete feature — schema, migration, memory pipeline, CLI, and dashboard surface together... there are no prescribed phases and no partial-delivery milestones.' The schema, doors, memory re-key, and dashboard surface are load-bearing for each other (partial delivery would strand half-keyed memory homes or a sidebar over missing tables). Decomposition is expressed as 27 small, independently reviewable items with explicit blocking edges instead of sibling issues.
